recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: forty-degree heat building over gironde vineyards
a new home for fiction on the open web
logs stripped to whispers before they reach the model
summer clear sky over san francisco, sixteen degrees
old blogs asking visitors to prove they're human

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Tap noise glyphs out of a scrolling terminal log before signal lines drown — each round saves one corrupted batch from flooding the screen.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: one clean log dump per 30-second round feels like a tiny win
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: noise glyph types multiply and signal lines shrink faster
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: phosphor green terminal glow on black

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Drag a single sentence through heat shimmer across sun-bleached pages to link the next micro-chapter of a beach novel.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: finish one micro-chapter arc in under 45 seconds
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: heat waves warp the path and wind nudges your line off-course

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Flick ember sparks upward through a grove before smoke swallows the canopy — each chain lights a new branch constellation.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: light three branch constellations before the grove dims
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: smoke thickens and wind shifts flick angles mid-round
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: watercolor ember trails on dusk orange

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Hold to charge a pocket agent, release to deploy it into parallel lanes of tiny tasks — swipe between lanes to compare outcomes side-by-side.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: launch three micro-agents from one thumb in under a minute
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: lanes accelerate and tasks fork mid-run requiring quick lane hops
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: neon wireframe agents on foggy SF summer night
